scripts.build:css: tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i assets/css/tailwind-source.css -o assets/css/tailwind.css --minify && tailwindcss -c tailwind.home.config.js -i assets/css/tailwind-source.css -o assets/css/tailwind-home.css --minify && tailwindcss -c tailwind.platform.config.js -i assets/css/tailwind-source.css -o assets/css/tailwind-platform.css --minify && tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i components/design-system.css -o components/design-system.min.css --minify
scripts.check:css: npm run build:css && git diff --exit-code -- assets/css/tailwind.css assets/css/tailwind-home.css assets/css/tailwind-platform.css components/design-system.min.css
scripts.check: npm run check:css && python3 scripts/render-shared-components.py --check && python3 scripts/validate-static-site.py && node scripts/validate-inline-js.js && node scripts/validate-intelligence-content.js
